effect.description: Choose an object that you can see within range. If the object is a door, a container, or a set of manacles, it becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked. If you choose a target that is held shut by arcane lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes. When you cast the spell, a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target object.
